newsitem.title: USA: Allergan Ligand cites data on compounds.
newsitem.headline: Allergan Ligand cites data on compounds.

text.p: Allergan Ligand Retinoid Therapeutics Inc said on Tuesday it expects two of its three advanced preclinical compounds are expected to be designated as clinical candidates for human trials during 1997.

"ALRT268, an retinoic acid receptor alpha agonist, and an RAR antagonist are all advancing swiftly through advanced pre-clinical evaluation, and we expect to make decisions selecting at least two of the three compounds this year to go into human trials in 1998," said president Marvin Rosenthale,
